note: header bar -- renders: logo, app name, burger menu toggle, search box label; the settings menu carries the user's display name and is subtracted
file app sidebar -- renders: Files, Favorites, Shared with you, Shared with others, Shared by link, Tags, Deleted files, Settings
file list toolbar -- renders: gallery view switcher, New button, upload progress; the breadcrumb carries user-named folder segments and is subtracted
table header row -- renders: column labels Name, Size, Modified, and Select-all checkbox; the file list panel and summary row are subtracted
favorite action links in file rows -- renders: Favorite; the file-name links (and share/more buttons nested inside them) are subtracted
share action button in file rows -- renders: Share
more action menu button in file rows -- renders: More
